title: platform-checklist: revise the items the #23878 full run and the #23879 since:v18 run found stale (knownGaps, steps, fixtures, oracles, source anchors across 15 areas; no clause red) — ledger follow-up
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a defect in the shipped QA ledger, with a named landing for each finding. The items below in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` describe a product that has moved on, through their knownGaps, steps, fixtures, oracle shapes or `source` anchors. **None of these makes a clause red.** The six that did were #23950, which landed in PR #24000. Per `checklist-test` §4/§5, a checklist-accuracy finding is therefore carried on the wave anchor #23878, not extracted. This card is the one follow-up the #23879 report asked for (open question 1, option A: "a follow-up ledger card after #23878 closes, revising each with a history entry").

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:devx` seat owning `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/**`. For each item:
- revise it per `checklist-test` §3: bump `revision`, append a `history` row naming this card, and keep `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` green;
- re-run the item once (`checklist-test` with the item selector) wherever the edit changes a fixture, a step's request or an oracle; a pure wording fix needs no re-run.

Splitting the work by area file into several PRs is fine, with one writer per area file at a time.

**Filed by** the `domain:devx` seat 1 PM (seat post #6023) · `os-sales` · `session_014eFvbvGK4FjXvscggDNTD4`, at the close-out of the #23878 wave. ⛔ This is not a claim.

## Sources (full evidence lives there)

- #23878 close-out 6216941109:
  - § "Checklist-accuracy findings", from the main runner: access-security, ai, search, api-backend, approvals, cli, integration-system, platform-core and records-forms. Some lines are cut at about 200 characters in that comment; where a line below ends early, re-measure on the item.
  - § "The two PM-carried readings".
- The cloud slices' reports on #23878:
  - 6216199424: dashboards;
  - 6216468427: automation;
  - 6216550639: studio-authoring;
  - 6216631966: identity-auth;
  - 6216814713: attachments-storage, i18n and ux-conventions.
  - The last sections of records #23951 and #23953.
- The #23879 report 6215306571, `out_of_scope_findings`: the stale existing items and the two carried readings.

## Already landed or dropped (not in scope here)

- **PR #24000** (#23950) landed:
  - `ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed` clauses 6 and 1;
  - all of `cli.migrate-meta-codemod`, r5, including the protocol-18 and step-8 notes;
  - `approvals.approver-resolution-matrix` clauses 4 and 5, plus the team and manager fixtures;
  - `platform-core.shell-nav-personalization` clause 5;
  - `platform-core.activation-ledger-row-contract` clause 4.
- **PR #24012** landed `identity-auth.api-key-ui-lifecycle` A2 (403 `API_KEY_REVOKED`).
- Findings on those revised items that still hold on `main` `fd0e72a` are listed below, marked "(residual)".
- **Dropped as disproved:** #23879's "`platform-core.shell-nav-personalization` drag reorder removed (unchecked)". #23939 drove pointer and keyboard reorder on clause 2, and both passed.

## access-security

- `capability-declaration-lifecycle`:
  - `sys_capability` is no longer a registered object (`GET /data/sys_capability` → 404 `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`), yet steps 7–8 still describe a `sys_capability` upsert (#23879 flags this too).
  - Step 3 says not to probe `/api/v1/actions/…`, but the dispatcher's `/actions` domain is mounted at `/api/v1/actions/:object/:action[/:recordId]` and enforces `actionPermissionError`. Name it as the surface to drive.
  - The REGRANT step edits `showcase_ops`, which is now sealed (`PUT /meta/permission/showcase_ops` → 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, ADR-0126). Use a scratch or cloned set carrying `showcase.export_data`.
- `record-share-grant-revoke` (carried reading, confirmed): source[1] says the record-shares family is "registered inline, under no registrar of its own". In fact `registerSharingEndpoints` (`packages/rest/src/sharing-routes.ts` L101) registers `GET`/`POST …/:id/shares` and `DELETE …/shares/:shareId`.
- `crud-permission-matrix`:
  - knownGaps[4] ("A1 is a KNOWN FAIL until #21057") is stale. #21057 closed on 2026-10-08; the seeded `sys_business_unit` rows carry `organization_id`, and the delegate's in-subtree `sys_user_position` create answers 201.
  - `access-matrix.json` has 45 rows (41 `showcase_*` plus 4 delegate × `sys_*`). Fixtures, knownGaps and steps still say 47 rows and 6 delegate rows.
- `sharing-rules-widen`:
  - The position-audience variant is confounded. The manager position binds `showcase_manager`, which has readScope `org` on `showcase_contact`, so the audience member sees non-matching contacts through depth (explain `decidedBy` depth).
  - Step 7 / clause 5 (A13) says "edit a materialized share", but `sys_record_share` is get/list only (PATCH → 405). The editable seeded artifact is the `sys_sharing_rule` row.
- `write-path-guards`: the steps leave out wire shapes:
  - `createMany` takes a bare JSON array, and `updateMany` takes `{records:[{id,data}]}`;
  - the bulk run stops at the first validation failure by default (later rows `NOT_ATTEMPTED`), which clause 6's mixed-outcome step has to account for.
- `readonly-package-locks-studio`, step 5:
  - The `POST /api/v1/packages` install door needs a manifest with `type` (for example `app`), or it answers 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`.
  - An object authored into the scratch base needs `sharingModel`, or it answers 422 `security-owd-unset`.
- `fls-mask-and-strip`, clause 3: it asks for the disabled state of three budget controls, but the edit form renders only `budget` and `spent`. `budget_remaining` is a formula and is not on the form.
- `audit-log-browser`, clause 0: a fresh member is refused `sys_audit_log` at object level (403), rather than being served an empty filtered list.
- `share-link-landing-page`: knownGaps[2] and history r2 say objectui `1fb1ced36243` is "still this repo's `.objectui-sha`". The pin is now `daeb77fc84dd`, and the behaviour still holds there.
- `share-link-capability-tokens`:
  - Clause 8 says public routes carry "exactly" `Vary: X-Share-Password, X-Share-Password-Encoding`. Live answers append `Origin` (the CORS middleware), and authenticated routes carry `Vary: Origin`. Reword it to "Vary includes".
  - #23879 also marks the item stale against v18's combined gates; see the new `access-security.share-link-combined-gates`.
- `sharing-rule-authoring-ui`:
  - knownGaps[0] says four rules are seeded and none covers `showcase_contact`. Stock serves two, one of them "Key-Account Qualified Contacts → Managers" on `showcase_contact` (position `manager`).
  - fixtures/source cite objectui `plugin-sharing/src/sharing-plugin.ts#nav_sharing_rules`, which does not exist at `daeb77fc`. The Setup nav comes from platform-objects' setup app.
- `record-view-read-audit`:
  - The install line logs at INFO and `os dev` defaults to `warn`, so "boot log lacks install line" is vacuous on a default boot. The steps should set `OS_LOG_LEVEL=info`.
  - The configured half has no stock fixture. A scripted scratch-copy recipe is worth adding: symlinked `node_modules` plus `@objectstack/plugin-audit` and `@objectstack/platform-objects`.
- `platform-owner-email-anchor`: the step order runs the malformed variant while M is still unverified, so its refusal cannot be told apart from the unverified arm. The well-formed-sibling check only bites once M is verified. Reorder the steps.
- `public-form-intake`:
  - Clause 1 speaks of "the server-stamped owner", but the landed anonymous row's `owner_id` is null. The forged value is stripped either way.
  - `/forms/contact-us` redirects to `/_console/f/contact-us`; `/_console/forms/:name` is the authed internal route.
  - The heading showing the raw view name is product-side; see the end of this card.
- `activation-write-operator-gate`: no API exposes the tenancy posture. The proof used was the boot banner line "Tenancy: single"; the item should name it.

## ai and search

- `ai.mcp-validate-expression`: fixtures and steps name `showcase_task.est_hours`, but the field is `estimate_hours` (`est_hours` answers "unknown field").
- `ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate`, step 1: it calls `list_actions` with `objectName`. `list_actions` takes no arguments and refuses it with `-32602` (unrecognized key).
- `ai.mcp-http-surface`, clause 4: the tool list omits `resume_run`, which `tools/list` now returns.
- `ai.agent-tool-skill-metadata-roundtrip`, clause 3: it says a GET with `?mode=draft` serves the active item or 404s. It now answers 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` "The mode query parameter is not supported by this endpoint".
- `ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed` (residual): `os start` sign-in needs an `Origin` header (403 `MISSING_OR_NULL_ORIGIN`). This is a runner note for minting keys on the start boot.
- `ai.skill-instructions-mcp-prompts`, step "flip active, reload metadata": under `os dev`, `/meta` serves the built dist artifact, so a restart alone leaves `/meta` stale against the MCP projection. Rebuild before re-listing.
- `search.pinyin-flag-both-sides`, clause 2: it lists `wf` as an account initials form, but `wf` is 王芳, a contact. The roster numbers 48/47 are now 52/51.
- `search.global-search-skips-unreadable`: knownGaps calls pinyin OFF "the stock default". On showcase the flag defaults ON through the zh-CN locale.

## api-backend

- `error-envelope-ledger`, step 6: it uses `options {atomic:false}`. `batch.zod` strips that, so the batch succeeds (200, creates a row). The `BATCH_NOT_ATOMIC` sample needs a top-level `atomic:false`, as `batch-transactional-discovery` already says.
- `bulk-write-contract`:
  - `updateMany`/`deleteMany` are id-based (`records[{id,data}]`, `ids[]`), so the steps' "where clause" body answers 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`.
  - The baseline member holds no `allowDelete` on the target object.
- `package-rest-lifecycle`, step 2:
  - The manifest's `scope: 'custom'` is invalid; the allowed values are `cloud|system|project`, and anything else answers 400.
  - The semver message reads "version must be a SemVer 2.0.0 string (e.g. 1.0.0, 2.0.0-beta.1)".
- `route-ledger-live-parity`: the REST ledger carries 18 families, since `reports` was retired (#20102). "19 REST families" and the variants list are stale.
- `server-timing-admin-gated`: the span list total/auth/db/hooks/serialize is stale. The hono adapter emits `parse`, `db`, `serialize`, `handler` and `total`.
- `rest-metadata-config-contract`: the masking step names `showcase_account`, but no stock persona has FLS there. The stock FLS fixture is `showcase_project`, where `client_liaison` cannot read `budget`/`spent`/`budget_remaining`.
- `aggregate-contract-matrix`: neither named restricted persona gives a differing visible set. Mei is refused 403 at the object gate, and Ada is VAMA. Use `search:qa-contributor-bound-member`.
- `batch-transactional-discovery`: the fixture says `showcase_task` accepts baseline creates, but a create needs the required `project` lookup.
- `enforce-or-remove-authoring-gates`: no concrete "silently-stripped-by-design display annotation" key is named, and none was found in spec docblocks. Name one, or drop the leg.
- `retired-def-refusal`: `RETIRED_DEFS` entries are schema-export definitions with no metadata-type binding or stack collection. "A stack that declares metadata of each sampled retired type" can therefore only be an invented key; reword the step.
- `declarative-endpoint-execution`: `os build` reports "3 APIs" on stock showcase, while the fixture text names two.
- `date-range-preset-matrix` (from #23879): the rolling presets now end today.

## approvals

- `approver-resolution-matrix` (residual): the fixtures still call `approver-bindings.flow.ts` "a DRAFT designer specimen, not a runnable fixture". Draft flows fire their triggers, so every `showcase_field_zoo` update opens an `admin_rescue` request. Reword this once #23965 settles the showcase flow.
- `ooo-delegation-reroute`: the knownGap "authoring the scratch flow needs a writable/scratch package" is stale. `POST /api/v1/automation` registers a runtime flow on stock showcase. The same holds for `approver-resolution-matrix` and `status-mirror-field`.
- `record-page-decisions`:
  - The both-sides clause should name a non-override persona: the dev admin sees Override Approve/Reject on a record routed away from them.
  - The item's route `/apps/showcase_app/showcase_project/:id` is not the served one; re-measure it.
- `pending-count-surfaces`: knownGap #7344 ("a plain member's notification count is structurally 0") did not hold. nina (contributor and finance positions) saw "2 notifications".
- `per-group-signoff`, clause 5: the wording ("actorId is a hint … regardless of any actorId") describes a silent override, but the server refuses a mismatched `actorId` with 403 "cannot act as". Align the wording with the stricter behaviour.
- `decision-action-matrix`: request-info is approver-only (the admin got 403 after reassigning away), so that step needs the pending approver.
- `email-action-token-door`: the step "reassign the bound approver away first" needs the approver themselves or a from-slot. An admin reassign replaces the caller's slot, so the target token stays live.
- `quorum-m-of-n`: the drawer's "N eligible approvers" counts duplicate slots. That is product-side (objectstack-ai/objectui#12781), with no ledger edit.

## attachments-storage

- `attach-requires-parent-edit` (from #23879): a non-reader outsider now gets 404.
- `download-authz-both-sides`, step 7: persona B never reaches the panel. The reachable shape is a stale panel after the grant is revoked.
- `sys-file-status-pipeline`, step 8 vs step 9: the hooked attach un-tombstones before any download.
- `upload-session-abort`, step 8: a bogus eTag list now answers 409 before the backend is called, so `failed` is reachable only through the test seam.
- `field-accept-maxsize-server-enforced`, knownGaps WIRE-ENVELOPE and clause 2: the wire is now 400 `ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT` with prose, not a sanitized 500.
- `qa-scratch-authz` recipe, step 6: members hold no baseline grant on runtime-authored objects. Pin the three permission-set payloads; their bodies are in #23929.

## automation

- `trigger-type-matrix`, `time-relative-trigger` and RUNNER: the schedule and time_relative legs need `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1`; on a default boot both showcase flows are unbound by deployment policy. #23879 flags the same, and also for `platform-core.notification-center`.
- `flow-node-type-matrix`, `flow-error-handling`, `packaged-flow-subflow-disable-refusal`, `connector-dispatch-matrix` and `flow-toggle-kill-switch`: "POST a task, PATCH done" fails as written. `showcase_task` requires `project`, and `status → done` is allowed only from `in_review` (`task_status_flow`).
- `trigger-status-contract`, clause 3: the `qa-flow-status-doors` recipe's `qa_always_fails` should author an `errorMessage`, or `details.errorMessage` never appears.
- `connector-dispatch-matrix` and RUNNER: `GET /automation/connectors` exposes no `baseUrl`. The premise-guard step and RUNNER's self-URL fact point at a key that isn't there.
- `packaged-flow-disable-durable`, clause 2: the activation-ledger boot line logs at info, so the log corroboration needs `--log-level info` (dev defaults to `warn`).
- `packaged-flow-clone-contract`, clause 6: the #21332 expected-fail is stale. Studio `/_console/studio/~org/automations` lists and opens the package-less clone.
- `flow-runs-page-test-trigger`, step 2: the step names the label "Batch Task Reminders (Loop)", but the picker shows machine names. That is a product defect (objectstack-ai/objectui#12783), so leave the step as written.
- `flow-node-type-matrix`, http node: the stock owners need egress. Success was located on a self-pinging scratch flow; name that recipe.

## cli

- `hook-body-extraction-gates`: the clause 6 EXPECTED-FAIL has flipped. The default build prints "N handlers could not be lowered…" with per-hook reasons, and `--json` carries `bodyExtractionWarnings`. The title, the clause and the knownGaps ("invisible on a default build") are stale (#23879, 22853).
- `build-own-contract`, step 6 (#3786 undeclared key): as written this is now a hard refusal, because object, field, report and enable shapes are closed. The advisory is reachable only at a nested strip-mode site (for example a field's `visibleWhen`) under `defineStack(…, {strict:false})`.
- `dev-automigrate-policy`: the fixture and steps are stale.
  - A config-declared datasource named `default` is refused by `defineStack`.
  - `required: true` no longer makes a NOT NULL column (`storage.notNull`, ADR-0113).
  - `relax_not_null` is `needs_confirm`, not safe.
- `migrate-duplicates-inventory`, step 5: the index recipe is stale. `sys_metadata` has no `organization_id`, and `idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active` is `(type,name,package_id,bundle_member)`.
- `doctor-health-report`: orphan-view staging needs `defineStack` `strict:false`. The default load refuses it, and doctor then skips config analysis.
- `dev-boot-contract`: the variant "config-declared default datasource" is a `datasourceMapping {default:true, datasource: NAME}` rule; a datasource literally named `default` is refused.
- `scaffold-console-first-paint`:
  - It probes port 3000, so runners confined to a port range must use `OS_PORT`/`-p`.
  - The published scaffold serves its own console, so this item does not exercise the vendored `.objectui-sha` bundle.
- `datasource-introspect-codegen`: wiring the draft into a scratch config requires the manifest namespace to equal the draft object's prefix.
- `scaffold-first-run` (from #23879): skills now come from `@objectstack/skills`.

## dashboards

- `cube-query`, clause 0: the verify text says "the meta response's `cubes[]` entry", but the wire is a bare array under `data`; there is no `cubes` wrapper (`analytics.zod.ts`).
- `dataset-report-authoring`, clause 5: "open_block totals + done_block totals == unfiltered totals" cannot be computed as written, because the blocks carry different measures. Reconcile it per measure.
- `chart-type-matrix` fixture requires[2]:
  - The compareTo probe needs a `dateRange`.
  - On the stock seed the previous 90-day window is empty, so the item needs tasks older than 90 days.
- `system-overview-live-counts`, clause 1: add a step that revokes or expires one session first.

## i18n (record #23951 notes)

- `notification-localized-and-clears`: knownGaps[0] and step 2 are stale.
  - `sys_user.locale` exists, and the avatar switcher writes `zh-CN`.
  - The notify node has a per-recipient `template` path.
  - Tokens use `{{ record.title }}`.
- `studio-follows-app-locale` and `surface-matrix`: the cited "451 untranslated declared labels" is now 414 (`scripts/i18n-coverage-baseline.json`).
- `studio-follows-app-locale`, clause 0: the premise is wrong. The Studio object editor's strings come from objectui's metadata-admin catalogue, not the served `metadataForms` group.
- `surface-matrix`:
  - variants[5] still marks the view-empty-state variant blocked(fixture), but it runs.
  - acceptance[7]'s group counts are off: the spec declares eleven per-app and twelve platform groups.
  - The `automated.ref` revision is stale.
  - The dashboards and pages steps should name the translated widget key and a platform page.

## identity-auth (report 6216631966)

- Mail capture in `self-service-password-reset`, `email-verification-loop` and `implicit-account-linking-ownership`: `EMAIL_TRANSPORT_PROVIDERS` is a const, not an env switch, and `LogTransport` logs no body or link. Name the `sys_email` row (admin `GET /api/v1/data/sys_email`) as the capture oracle.
- `self-signup-gate` (step 6 / A4) and `first-run-owner-bootstrap` (step 8 / A4): on an `OS_DISABLE_SIGNUP` boot, an uninvited forge is refused first by the audience gate (403 `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`). Only an invited address reaches the toggle (400 `EMAIL_PASSWORD_SIGN_UP_DISABLED`). Say which address proves which door.
- `self-signup-gate`: the knownGap is stale. The open posture through the env door is now measured live.
- `email-verification-loop`:
  - A2: verify answers `{status:true,user:null}`, so don't imply a user object.
  - A3: a consumed token for an already-verified user answers a silent 200.
- `two-factor-verify-to-activate`, A1 / step 3: the cookie-lane `TOTP_NOT_ENABLED` branch is unreachable over HTTP.
- `two-factor-enrollment-reveal`, A4: `get-totp-uri` re-reveals the same secret. "Shown only once" holds only for backup codes; reword it or record that as accepted design.
- `two-factor-backup-codes`, step 8: it cites "step-5 regenerate", but the regenerate is step 4.
- `api-key-ui-lifecycle` (residual):
  - `showcase_task` returns the same rows to member and admin, so it cannot discriminate; use `sys_session`.
  - The Integrations page is at `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.account/developer/integrations`.
- `session-list-revoke`:
  - `revoked_at` and `revoke_reason` live on the `revoked` view.
  - The owner's raw list includes their own tombstones.
- `workspace-org-switch`: the sentinel-absent check holds only under `isolated`.
- `invitation-scope-gates`:
  - Step 7: cancel is owner/admin only.
  - The invite affordance lives at `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.account/sys_invitation`, which no nav entry links to.
- `org-membership-team-management`, A4: name an org-membership-scoped oracle, because `everyone` baseline reads survive remove-member on the `single` posture.
- `admin-lifecycle-operations`: Impersonate is only in the Users list row menu.
- `linked-accounts-social`:
  - `sys_account` apiMethods are live `[get,list,aggregate,export]`; r4 on `main` still says `['get','list']`.
  - `link_social` is retired, so A3 cannot discriminate.
  - The callbackURL lands on the "All" tab.
- `sso-enforced-first-paint`:
  - Step 5 is outside the console's watchdog, which covers only the hung sign-in request (20 s).
  - The sign-up half of A2 cannot discriminate on invite_only showcase.
- `auth-method-matrix`:
  - The no-SMS state needs `NODE_ENV=production`.
  - Generic `oidcProviders` surface as `socialProviders[]` of type `oidc`, while `features.sso` tracks only `@better-auth/sso`.
  - Magic-link is off on stock (404).
  - Generic OIDC is drivable with a localhost IdP.
- `oauth-app-consent-loop`, step 2: `create-client` defaults to type `web`, which refuses http and loopback redirect URIs. Use an https non-loopback URI.
- Design observations to rule on, not edit:
  - `two-factor-disable-lifecycle`: an MFA-gated admin gets 403 `MFA_REQUIRED` on `PUT /api/settings/auth`.
  - `two-factor-enrollment-reveal`: the secret re-reveal noted above.

## integration-system

- `job-scheduled-run`:
  - Fixtures and steps do not name `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED`.
  - acceptance[4] calls the `enabled:false` skip LOUD, but it logs at debug.
- `notify-inbox-delivery`, acceptance[4]: it says the dispatcher records the dead-letter. In fact emit refuses the delivery row up front (WARN "refused 1 delivery row(s)…"), and no `sys_notification_delivery` row exists.
- `external-datasource-federated-read`: OData `$filter` is refused with 400 `INVALID_FILTER`. The JSON `filter` param and `top` work.
- `email-template-render`, knownGaps[1]: name the workable door, a scratch notify flow authored through `POST /api/v1/automation` that lands in `sys_email`.
- `notification-preference-suppression`, acceptance[4] "with locale fallback": the store ladder only walks down (en-US → en), so a recipient with no locale resolves `en` and an en-US-only template row is never used. Author the fixture row at a locale the ladder reaches.
- `flow-connector-picker`: the picker is a native datalist that a screenshot cannot show open. Say to read it from the DOM.
- `webhook-lifecycle`: creating a `showcase_task` needs `project`.

## platform-core

- `settings-hub-roundtrip`:
  - steps[1]: on `os dev --seed-admin` the dev seed already writes `localization.timezone` at tenant scope.
  - Clause 11 / steps[11] expect anon 403 `SETTINGS_FORBIDDEN`. The ADR-0056 D2 floor answers 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED` first.
  - Clause 7 names `sys_setting.value_enc`, but global-scope secrets live in `sys_platform_setting.value_enc`.
  - steps[3] has no stock observable for the analytics date bucket.
- `metadata-authoring-roundtrip`:
  - steps[1]: a plain PUT saves `state=active`. `?mode=draft` is required, and view names must be qualified (`OBJECT.view`).
  - Clause 2: the create form is `/_console/apps/showcase_app/metadata/page/new`, and Page type defaults to "list".
- `manifest-install-contract`:
  - The steps use `scope:"custom"`, which is refused.
  - The legacy `engine.objectstack` range must be full semver (`^17.0.0`).
- `app-management-toggle`, knownGap and clause 5: it is 403 `ITEM_LOCKED`, not `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`. Delete shows an info toast on `reset:false`.
- `shell-nav-personalization` (residual): the favorites star is in the record header's More actions menu ("Add to favorites"), and nav pinning is under the per-entry More actions menu. There is no hover pin button and no star button.
- `notification-center`:
  - `GET /notifications?view=mine` rows carry no `notification_id`.
  - The scheduled-digest fixture needs `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED` (#23879).
- `activation-ledger-registration-home`, acceptance[3]: `sys_automation_run` is a same-answer parity check (both undefined), not an anti-vacuity control.
- `activation-ledger-row-contract` (residual):
  - The 405 `allowed` set is `[get,list,aggregate,search,export]`, not apiMethods `['get','list']`.
  - PRAGMA also lists a `__search` column.
- `packaged-object-extend-only`, steps[2] (#23879 too): the `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` refusal now reads "provided by a managed package and is sealed", in one sentence.
- `marketplace-install-local-lifecycle`: `storageDir` sits on the listing envelope, not on each entry.
- `marketplace-console-honesty`, steps[2] / acceptance[2]: reseed and purge are in the package Details page's "More install options" menu (objectui#11627), not on the Installed Apps list. The stale note is objectui#12684.
- `lifecycle-retention-sweep`: the knownGaps say there is no telemetry datasource on stock. Stock `serve` now provisions one (`data.telemetry.db`).
- `seed-mode-matrix`:
  - The seed body refuses a `name` key, and a scratch object needs `sharingModel`.
  - Replace routing is at `seed-loader.ts` ~2650, not `:2106`.
- `settings-audit-secret-fingerprint`: the non-secret digest is FNV-1a 32 (`fnv32:`) of canonical JSON, not SHA-256. Step 6, acceptance[4] and the N4 control must compute FNV-1a.
- `keyboard-shortcut-surface`: the settled inventory matches steps[3] at `daeb77fc` too; update the pin note.
